Per-entry verified (RFC 0083 audit, re-bucketing an RFC 0047 baseline seed): NOT bucket (b) equivalent or (c) noise — this is a real unported call. Rails merger.rb:117-134 pushes the cross-klass JoinDependency into the receiver's `joins_values` via `relation.joins!(join_dependency, *others)` at :132, so `build_join_buckets` routes it through `select_named_joins` → `select_association_list` (query_methods.rb:1810-1822), which stashes it into `buckets[:stashed_join]`. trails' `mergeJoins` (relation/merger.ts:96-98) delegates to `foldMergeJoins` (relation/merge-joins.ts:84-93), which parks the JD in the side store `_namedInnerJoinDeps` instead; `emitJoinPlan` (relation/query-methods.ts:3084-3087) then appends its constraints straight to the manager, bypassing bucket routing entirely. Tracked by RFC 0083 stories converge-merged-join-deps-into-joins-values, converge-apply-join-dependency-joins-bang and port-build-join-buckets-eager-stash-pop.
